macros.name: itswitch
macros.doc: \itswitch calls \itshape if the current font is not italic, and \upshape if the current font is italic.

macros.name: slswitch
macros.doc: \slswitch calls \slshape if the current font is not slanted, and \upshape if the current font is slanted.

macros.name: textitswitch
macros.doc: \textitswitch {⟨text⟩} sets its argument with \itshape if the current font is not italic, or \upshape if the current font is italic.

macros.name: textslswitch
macros.doc: \textslswitch {⟨text⟩} sets its argument with \slshape if the current font is not slanted, or \upshape if the current font is slanted.
